_meta.role: reference/fasit agent -- unlimited time/token budget, produces the ground-truth answer the other two arms are scored against; may use quarry itself if helpful and is told to cross-check with more than one method

key_symbols.name: attachCmd
key_symbols.role: Reads the operator's own terminal size with term.GetSize(os.Stdout.Fd()) and passes it to Engine.AttachArgv, degrading to (0,0) plus a logger.Warn on a non-TTY rather than aborting.

key_symbols.name: Engine.AttachArgv
key_symbols.role: Builds the attach argv, chaining a select-layout planned against the attaching client's told cols/rows onto attach-session; returns no error and degrades to the bare argv on every failure.

key_symbols.name: bareAttachArgv
key_symbols.role: The five-element unchained fallback argv.

key_symbols.name: chainedAttachArgv
key_symbols.role: Appends the literal one-character ';' separator plus select-layout to the bare argv.

key_symbols.name: errAttachChainSuppressed
key_symbols.role: Sentinel marking a benign precondition failure so the single warn-and-degrade tail returns the bare argv.

key_symbols.name: Engine.liveBoxLocked
key_symbols.role: Reads the live window size via display-message and falls back to cfg.Width/cfg.Height on error or a malformed answer.

key_symbols.name: parseWindowSize
key_symbols.role: Pure parser requiring exactly two whitespace-separated strictly-positive integers from the window-size query.

key_symbols.name: Engine.pinGeometryOptionsLocked
key_symbols.role: Session/window-targeted pins of status off and window-size latest, issued at boot and again in AttachArgv's pre-flight.

key_symbols.name: Engine.readWindowSizeLatestLocked
key_symbols.role: Reads the effective window-size back and gates the attach chain on it being exactly latest.

key_symbols.name: Engine.readStatusRowsLocked
key_symbols.role: Reads the effective status back and converts it to reserved rows subtracted from the told box height.

key_symbols.name: reservedRowsFromStatus
key_symbols.role: Maps a status readback to reserved rows; any other value reports ok=false and suppresses the chain.

key_symbols.name: windowSizeAllowsChain
key_symbols.role: Reports whether a window-size readback permits chaining.

key_symbols.name: Engine.planLayout
key_symbols.role: The told-box seam: computes the window_layout string and focus pane against a caller-supplied render.Box, querying tmux for nothing.

key_symbols.name: Engine.applyLayoutLocked
key_symbols.role: The ordinary-op reconciliation: resolves a fresh live box via liveBoxLocked, re-plans, and applies select-layout/select-pane.

key_symbols.name: anyPlacedStrand
key_symbols.role: Guard preventing a zero-pane layout string, which tmux answers by destroying every pane.

key_symbols.name: Engine.reconcileApplyPersistLocked
key_symbols.role: Shared tail of every mutating op that re-enumerates panes, reconciles bindings, re-applies the layout against the live window, and persists state.

key_symbols.name: Engine.ensureServerAndSessionLocked
key_symbols.role: Boots the session with new-session -x/-y and issues the first pinGeometryOptionsLocked; boot pins never re-apply to an already-up session.

key_symbols.name: buildStackBody
key_symbols.role: Emits the box's W/H as the layout string's root cell -- the dimensions tmux compares against the live window.

key_symbols.name: Config.Width / Config.Height
key_symbols.role: The configured boot size and the only fallback box when the live window size cannot be read.

key_symbols.name: ReedState
key_symbols.role: The persisted reed.json record -- carries NO width/height, which is why there is no stored-vs-fresh terminal-size comparison anywhere.

summary: Terminal geometry is never persisted in reed.json; it is read fresh at two places and funnelled into one told-box seam. On attach, internal/reedcli/attach.go reads the operator's own terminal with term.GetSize and hands cols/rows to Engine.AttachArgv, which under a single op lock re-pins status off and window-size latest, reads both options' EFFECTIVE values back with display-message (a set-option exit 0 is not proof the pin took), converts status into reserved rows, applies a floor, and calls planLayout against a told render.Box -- never liveBoxLocked, since at argv-build time the live window is still the pre-attach size. The resulting argv chains select-layout after attach-session so tmux first resizes the window to the new client and only then applies a layout string already sized to that client, landing verbatim instead of being silently rescaled proportionally by tmux. Mismatch handling degrades to the bare unchained attach argv with a warn on any precondition failure (bad readback, missing session, too few panes, no placed strand); a pane-set race between plan and exec is caught by tmux itself refusing the mismatched layout. For every non-attach op, reconcileApplyPersistLocked -> applyLayoutLocked resolves a FRESH live box and re-plans. A resize while already attached triggers no reed-side reaction at all -- tmux's own proportional rescale governs until the next lyx reed op re-renders, a gap explicitly deferred to a future watchdog daemon.
